about.title: about.
about.p1: Information Systems graduate from Universitas Dinamika with a 3.78 GPA, now working full-time as Digital Marketing Specialist & Technical Administration at PT. Anugrah Cipta Management.
about.p2: I handle two business lines at once: ISO/NSM certification services for institutions, companies, and foundations; and IWASH cleaning services for household consumers. My role goes beyond running ads — designing promotional materials, managing audiences, following up on leads, issuing invoices, and overseeing the certification process through to certificate issuance.
about.p3: Outside my main job, I create flyer designs, edit promotional videos, and manage social media — because the right content is the fuel behind advertising that actually works.

brand.lead: Two brands, two very different audiences. One approach: visual material that stays consistent all year, tuned to whatever moment the audience is talking about.
brand.brand_iso_desc: ISO certification for institutions, companies, and foundations. The audience is B2B decision makers — they need credibility, regulation, and clear pricing.
brand.brand_iso_point1: Seasonal angles: Mid Year, End Year, Independence Day
brand.brand_iso_point2: Regulatory angle: mandatory HACCP & ISO for SPPG kitchens
brand.brand_iwash_desc: Deep cleaning of soft furniture for households. The audience is the end consumer — they need a low entry price and trust.
brand.brand_iwash_point2: Reasons to choose: free transport, no down payment, mite-free
brand.seasonal_desc: Flyers are not made just to look busy. Each moment ties directly to a paid campaign — and the results are measurable.
